import json, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path('scripts/shader-fuzz').resolve()))
from run import decode_case, check_semantics
from spirv_oracle import metrics

root = Path(sys.argv[1]); records = []
validator = Path('.dotnet/packs/Sia.Spirv.Toolchain.win-x64/0.0.22/tools/win-x64/spirv-val.exe').resolve()
manifest = json.loads(Path('.work/shader-fuzz-optimization/inputs.json').read_text())
for source in manifest:
    name = source['Name']; binary = root / (name + '.spv')
    if not binary.exists():
        records.append({'Name': name, 'Kind': 'compile_failure'}); continue
    validation = subprocess.run([str(validator), '--target-env', 'vulkan1.1', str(binary)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
    if validation.returncode:
        records.append({'Name': name, 'Kind': 'invalid_spirv', 'Error': validation.stderr}); continue
    case = decode_case(json.loads(Path(source['Case']).read_text()))
    try:
        result = check_semantics(binary.read_bytes(), case)
    except Exception as error:
        result = {'kind': 'harness_error', 'detail': repr(error)}
    records.append({'Name': name, 'Kind': result.pop('kind'), **result, 'Metrics': metrics(binary.read_bytes())})
(root / 'checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(records, indent=2))
from collections import Counter
print(json.dumps(dict(Counter(r['Kind'] for r in records))))

import json, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path('scripts/shader-fuzz').resolve()))
from run import decode_case, check_semantics
root = Path('.work/shader-fuzz-optimization'); out = root / 'cross'; out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
manifest = json.loads((root / 'inputs.json').read_text())
validator = Path('.dotnet/packs/Sia.Spirv.Toolchain.win-x64/0.0.22/tools/win-x64/spirv-val.exe').resolve()
tools = { 'tint': str(Path('.cache/upstream-compilers/tint-build/tint.exe').resolve()),
          'naga': str(Path('.cache/upstream-compilers/naga-build/release/naga.exe').resolve()) }
records=[]
for index, source in enumerate(manifest):
    name=source['Name']; wgsl=root/'after'/(name+'.wgsl')
    case=decode_case(json.loads(Path(source['Case']).read_text()))
    for tool, executable in tools.items():
        binary=out/(name+'-'+tool+'.spv')
        arguments=[executable,str(wgsl),'--format','spirv','--spirv-version','1.3','--disable-robustness','-o',str(binary)] if tool=='tint' else [executable,'--spirv-version','1.3','--index-bounds-check-policy','Unchecked','--buffer-bounds-check-policy','Unchecked',str(wgsl),str(binary)]
        run=subprocess.run(arguments,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace',timeout=15)
        record={'Name':name,'Tool':tool,'Exit':run.returncode,'Error':run.stderr,'Command':arguments}
        if run.returncode==0:
            validation=subprocess.run([str(validator),'--target-env','vulkan1.1',str(binary)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
            record.update(Validation=validation.returncode,ValidationError=validation.stderr)
            if validation.returncode==0:
                record.update(check_semantics(binary.read_bytes(),case))
        records.append(record)
    if (index+1)%32==0:
        (out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2))
        print(index+1,'sources',flush=True)
(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2))
from collections import Counter
print(json.dumps(dict(Counter((r['Tool']+':'+r.get('kind','compile_or_validation_failure')) for r in records))))
